## E. Graded analytic tails close the non-RWA replication interface

An initial review left four-packet domain regularity open; finite-particle
approximation alone did not discharge four unbounded creation operators.
The following owner-derived argument closes that obligation for the stated
bounded-band massive model. It is not attributed to an unacquired producer
program or to the independent audit's explicitly written two-packet proof.

First,a reusable graded analytic lemma. Let H0 preserve a nonnegative integer
grading N,and let V change that grading by at most one. Assume H(g)=H0+gV
has a common-domain analytic family and a simple isolated bare eigenvector
psi0 of grading0. On a sufficiently small complex disk its Riesz projection
P(g) is analytic; psi(g)=P(g)psi0 is nonzero near0. In the resolvent Neumann
expansion,H0 resolvents preserve N and a coefficient of order k has k factors
of V. Therefore the Taylor coefficient psi_k has grading at most k. Choose
any contour radius R strictly inside that analytic disk and write
C_R=sup_(|z|=R)||psi(z)||. Cauchy's coefficient bound gives

    ||1_(N>=M) psi(g)|| <= C_R (|g|/R)^M/(1-|g|/R),  |g|<R.

The tail of a normalized vector additionally divides by ||psi(g)||>0. The
geometric bound proves every polynomial N moment is finite. It supplies no
numerical radius or acquired C_R when those quantities are unspecified.

For the spring model,the bare ground is |gg,0>. Its free sector gap is
positive because the bath mass m>0. The acquired source/audit supplies the
common-domain analytic perturbation argument. H0 preserves normal-mode photon
number,and every sigma_x q vertex changes that number by one. Thus the lemma
applies to its dressed ground. Also the one-photon frequency operator is
bounded above and below,so these number moments imply all domains needed for
four creation operators and their H(g) commutators.

Choose four normalized free lower-band wavepackets f_j,r,with lengths growing
and supports translated far down the rails. Bulk truncated Bloch waves of
the symmetric rail combination give ||(K-omega_j^2)f_j,r||->0 for any interior
lower-band frequency omega_j. Positivity gives
||(sqrt(K)-omega_j)f_j,r||<=||(K-omega_j^2)f_j,r||/(m+omega_j). Their overlaps
with the fixed endpoint form factors tend to0. They may be separated spatially.
